observations.command:
set -eu
date -u
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
cat /proc/uptime
T=/sys/kernel/debug/tracing
echo '@@ TRACE_OPTIONS'
cat "$T/trace_options"
echo '@@ EVENT_FORK'
if test -r "$T/options/event-fork"; then cat "$T/options/event-fork"; else echo unavailable; fi
echo '@@ SET_EVENT_PID'
if test -r "$T/set_event_pid"; then cat "$T/set_event_pid"; else echo unavailable; fi
echo '@@ FORK_FORMAT'
if test -r "$T/events/sched/sched_process_fork/format"; then cat "$T/events/sched/sched_process_fork/format"; else echo unavailable; fi
echo '@@ SYSCALL_FORMAT'
cat "$T/events/raw_syscalls/sys_enter/format"
